cells.gaps: No share of local offices registering births digitally is published: the one figure is of equipment, tablets and connected routers for birth registration in 174 of the 233 civil-status centres of five northern departments in 2023 (BEN-049), and the maternity one-stop desk is still in its ten facilities in 2026. How the remaining centres make the record, and whether deaths are entered at the office, is not described. No plan with a period is on record, and finance disagrees: donor support on the newest fact (BEN-009), self-financing with no budget line named in the playbook (BEN-043).
cells.note: Equipment for digital birth registration reached 174 civil-status centres in five departments in 2023, beyond the ten maternity pilot desks: a share of offices equipped places the cell at rung 3. Rung 4 needs a published share of offices registering births at the office, which is not held.
